newsitem.title: GERMANY: Moody's confirms Henkel commercial paper rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Henkel commercial paper rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service on Thursday confirmed its Prime-1 rating for commercial paper of Henkel KGaA following the company's announcement of plans to buy the 65 percent of Loctite Corp it does not already own.

In a statement first issued in New York, Moody's said the transaction would strengthen Henkel's position in the industrial and consumer adhesive markets, but the deal also meant its debt reduction measures could "significantly decline" if the transaction is to be mostly or completely debt-financed.
Earlier this week, Standard & Poor's said it placed its AA minus senior unsecured and A1 plus commercial paper ratings of Henkel on CreditWatch with negative implications.
S&P said it was also worried about Henkel's debt levels.
